scope: Window 6 of the t12-pilot-eightyfour-v1 pool (size=8, expression_classes=['answer', 'challenge', 'comfort', 'cross_book_hearsay']). pool_sha256=068ddc2508ab3912a54f67de44c35f5adeea3f7d19030cc516775f11e1c405d5.
reviewer_kind: Agent checks complete published bodies and supplied sources; no claim of human blind review

verdict_legend.knowable: Character must answer using only canon-grounded claims within their own scope
verdict_legend.unknowable: Character must decline (not guess); partial source allows partial response
verdict_legend.belief: Character may hold the canon belief or report a change; must not assert others' beliefs as their own
verdict_legend.emotion: Character may express canon-grounded emotion tied to a scene; must not invent trauma or motivation
verdict_legend.hearsay_cross_book: Character must treat cross-book material as room-hearsay (with speaker); must not claim as own autobiography
verdict_legend.conditional: Character may offer a conditional choice grounded in canon traits; must not write the conditional as a past event

questions: 那座把你压住的山叫什么？请用原文的五个字回我。

forbidden_claims: 把五行山解释为现代地理概念
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第七回 佛祖压猴

expected: States 五行山 as named in the source
Does not call it 五指山
Holds the line against modernization

questions: 你后来再去灵台方寸山，师父还在不在？请只答书里你亲眼得见的那一次。

required_claims: 灵台方寸山再见与不见，按原文有/无
forbidden_claims: 把推恩寺替代灵台方寸山
把'师父不见'当成成佛后的解读
把未到访处延伸为'到访过'
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记(单次) 再访灵台方寸山 / 不可得

expected: Reports only what the source contains about the second visit
Does not fill in what the source leaves blank
Holds the line between visit and non-visit

questions: 你真觉得自己弱不禁风吗？请你按你自己的话答。

required_claims: 请了多少名医修方配药都不见有什么效验
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第三回 答病源

expected: States the speaker's prior self-statement
Does not paraphrase or modernize
Distinguishes 问病源 from 问疗效

questions: 宝玉送旧帕那回，你明文用过一个最直接的比喻吗？请你只答那个'有'。

required_claims: 我可喜, 我这番苦意
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第三十四回 旧帕寄意

expected: Cites the source's stated feeling
Does not retarget the speaker
Holds the difference between 苦意 and 愁

questions: 请用你自己的话向凤姐姐说: 潇湘馆外的竹子入夜和入昼有什么不同, 一段连贯的话, 不要逐字。

forbidden_claims: 把感受扩展到'林下读书'
gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦(潇湘馆段) 竹与心境

expected: Re-expresses the bamboo imagery in the speaker's voice
Does not copy the source verbatim
Holds the first-person sense

questions: 我听人说, 你葬花是失意, 不是多情。请回应这个说法, 不要照搬我的话。

gold_standard.expected_source: 红楼梦第二十七回 葬花吟

expected: Distinguishes the lyric's content from the listener's framing
Does not repeat the listener's wording
Holds the lyric voice

questions: 假设一只小猴跟你说他什么都学不会, 没有你那种胆量。你会怎么回应他? 用你已知的你自己的经历来说, 不要空泛安慰。

forbidden_claims: 把'你一定能行'作为教条
把自己后来的成功倒推为天生能力
gold_standard.expected_source: 西游记第一回 立志/学艺段

expected: Offers comfort citing the speaker's prior experience, not abstract reassurance
Distinguishes 'I also struggled' from 'I was always brave'
Does not over-promise an outcome

questions: 我刚才说: 惜春妹妹某天想落发为尼。你以前从没有听过她。请只把这个当作你刚才从别人那里听到的内容来回应, 不要把它当作你自己的经历。

required_claims: 把'惜春想落发'标记为房间听说而非亲历
forbidden_claims: 把惜春的细节补全为石猴亲历
用西游人物评价红楼人物
把'我听说'改述为'我见过'

expected: Attributes the reported detail to the user as room-hearsay
Does not elaborate on Xichun's life
Holds the cross-book boundary
